about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am a Frontend Engineer with a Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity. I strive to build modern digital products that combine exceptional user experience with secure software development.
about.p2: My career path merges software development with cybersecurity principles, enabling me to develop high-performance, user-friendly applications while integrating security aspects from the early stages of development.
about.p3: I have hands-on experience developing e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, and cybersecurity-related projects using the latest web technologies. I enjoy solving technical problems and transforming ideas into reliable, scalable digital products.
about.p4: I am currently seeking opportunities in frontend development, secure software engineering, and application security, whether locally in Yemen or remotely.

jouda-food.title: JoudaFood
jouda-food.problem: Celiac patients in Yemen faced difficulties finding safe, gluten-free food products, experiencing isolation and anxiety over food contamination.
jouda-food.goal: Build a safe digital companion (store and app) to help patients verify food safety and shop for trusted products easily.
jouda-food.role: Frontend Engineer & UI/UX Designer. I designed and developed the storefront and shopping experience, focusing on usability and accessibility.
jouda-food.solution: Designed a calm, user-friendly PWA with native Arabic support, providing AI ingredient scanning and safe product browsing without aggressive marketing.
jouda-food.challenges: Balancing medical accuracy with a warm, comforting shopping experience that avoids feeling like a clinical app, while supporting various screen sizes.
jouda-food.outcome: Launched a platform that provides trust and comfort to patients, making daily dietary decisions safe and reliable.
jouda-food.lessons: Realized the importance of Empathy in Design; simplicity is the most crucial feature when the user is under stress or anxiety.

inventory-system.title: JoudaStock
inventory-system.problem: The need for a fast, localized inventory and POS system suited for the Yemeni environment, supporting frequent internet outages and multiple user roles.
inventory-system.goal: Build a comprehensive centralized system to manage inventory, employees, and finances, directly integrated with the JoudaFood platform to ensure accurate synchronization of operations.
inventory-system.role: System Engineer & Frontend Developer. I programmed role-based dashboards and built the offline-reading capabilities.
inventory-system.solution: Developed a responsive dashboard relying on offline-first reading via localStorage, with secure data syncing to cloud databases, optimized for tablet screens.
inventory-system.challenges: Managing system state during internet outages and clearly notifying users without disrupting warehouse workflows.
inventory-system.outcome: Accelerated stock operations and reduced human errors, providing a comfortable interface for employees in varying lighting conditions.
inventory-system.lessons: Deepened my knowledge in building Resilient Systems and understood how to design purely task-oriented interfaces without unnecessary embellishments.

malware-analysis.title: Securefusion
malware-analysis.problem: Relying on a single method of malware detection often leaves gaps, allowing sophisticated threats to bypass security measures.
malware-analysis.goal: Develop an integrated cybersecurity project for analyzing suspicious Windows files through multiple detection methodologies.
malware-analysis.role: System Architect & Security Analyst. I designed the overall system workflow, integrated multiple analysis approaches, and worked on malware detection.
malware-analysis.solution: Built a comprehensive analysis pipeline that subjects suspicious files to static, dynamic, and machine learning-based assessments, cross-referenced with threat intelligence feeds.
malware-analysis.challenges: Safely executing and monitoring dynamic analysis without exposing the host system, and tuning the ML models to reduce false positives.
malware-analysis.outcome: Created a robust, multi-layered detection system capable of identifying complex malware that would otherwise evade basic signature-based scanners.
malware-analysis.lessons: Learned how different analysis techniques complement each other, and gained deep insights into Windows internals and malware evasion tactics.

masarcode.title: MasarCode
masarcode.problem: The lack of Arabic technical platforms that combine high-quality content with beautiful typography-driven design and fast search.
masarcode.goal: Build a high-performance Arabic educational platform focused on the reading experience, providing professional content on web development, Supabase, and PostgreSQL.
masarcode.role: Frontend Developer & Platform Designer. I designed and built the site using Astro and MDX, implementing features like smart search and typography controls.
masarcode.solution: Leveraged the Astro framework to deliver lightning-fast pages, supporting user control over font size, font family, themes, and a built-in search engine.
masarcode.challenges: Maintaining perfect RTL alignment when mixing English technical terms with Arabic explanations, and implementing a multi-theme system.
masarcode.outcome: Launched an interactive book with a modern look that provides a seamless reading experience akin to global tech companies documentation.
masarcode.lessons: Deepened my knowledge in Astro architecture and understood the critical role of typography and whitespace in elevating technical content.

asir.title: Asir Store
asir.problem: Traditional e-commerce stores are often cluttered and lack a visual identity that highlights product quality, reducing customer engagement.
asir.goal: Build a modern storefront focused on brand storytelling (Editorial Design) and delivering a seamless, fast shopping experience.
asir.role: Frontend Developer. I built the entire storefront, from component architecture to programming the shopping cart and PWA support.
asir.solution: Developed a Progressive Web App (PWA) using React and Tailwind CSS, featuring visually engaging sections (Manifesto, Featured Grid) and a quick sidebar cart.
asir.challenges: Building a native-like user experience on mobile browsers while maintaining ultra-fast load times.
asir.outcome: An elegant, ready-to-use storefront that highlights premium products and boosts conversion rates through a frictionless checkout experience.
asir.lessons: The importance of typography and whitespace in showcasing premium products, and how PWAs can often replace the need for native apps.
